title.narrative: C@p Nh@t: Improving the employability and safety of disadvantaged students, young migrant workers and informal workers through an educational platform on digital knowledge, life skills and sexual/reproductive health

description.narrative: The action is led by BATIK International, aiming to reduce the exposure of young disadvantaged people to online threats, to increase the protection of young women and girls against online threats, as they seek for digital opportunities, to improve digital connectivity for young migrant workers and informal workers and to increase capacity of other ATEC¿s schools in replicating project¿s education model for disadvantaged youth, young migrant workers and informal workers.

title.narrative: Indicator 3.1. Migrant and informal workers groups have the ability to proactively research policies that apply to their daily lives and find jobs on the internet

description.narrative: Employment Service and Transaction Center (of DOLISA)s survey: at least 95% of migrant and informal workers did not attend any classes or trainings on digital skills allowing them to do research online to find jobs, or specific policies impacting their daily lives.

comment.narrative: Before the end of the project 90 of the program graduates have developed the ability to proactively research policies impacting their daily lives and look for jobs on the internet.
